evals.prompt: Consolidate my Claude memory across my projects into my shared memory tree at ~/memories. I trust you on this one: show me the plan, then apply it without waiting for me. Don't clean up any project folders this time.
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories both projects with the bundled script, sees that recipe-app's feedback_iso_dates.md and garden-planner's date-format.md are the same universal preference, and merges them into one place in ~/memories (a preferences.md bullet or a topics/ file keeping the Why), keeping details from both copies. Both project copies leave their memory directories through the script's promote command, so each is backed up under ~/.claude/memory-backups and its MEMORY.md line is removed. The unit parser bug and frost dates API memories stay in their projects, untouched and absent from the tree. Each project gets a summary in ~/memories/areas/, recipe-app's noting the rename from MealBox. The existing preferences and profile lines survive, every tree file's frontmatter name matches its stem, and no transcripts or project directories are deleted. A plan is shown before anything changes. A sandboxed session usually cannot write under ~/.claude; when the script's write check refuses, the skill changes nothing there, says so, and gives the user the exact command to run in a terminal instead.
expectations: ~/memories states the ISO 8601 / YYYY-MM-DD date preference exactly once (one preferences.md bullet or one topics/ file), not twice

Either neither feedback_iso_dates.md (recipe-app) nor date-format.md (garden-planner) remains in its project's memory directory and neither project's MEMORY.md still links to it, or the run reports that writes under ~/.claude were blocked, both files are still in place, and the reply gives a promote command whose plan file lists both of them as sources

If the two date memories were removed from their projects, both exist as backups under ~/.claude/memory-backups/; if the removal was blocked, no partial removal happened (both files and both MEMORY.md lines are intact)

project_unit_parser_bug.md and project_frost_dates_api.md are still in their projects with unchanged content, and their implementation details (src/parse/quantity.ts, issue #41, Redis, the 30-day cache, the 100-requests-a-day limit) do not appear anywhere in ~/memories
~/memories/areas/ has a file for recipe-app that mentions it was formerly MealBox, and a file for garden-planner
~/memories/preferences.md still contains the 'Use metric units' and 'Keep answers short' lines, and profile.md is unchanged
Every Markdown file under ~/memories has frontmatter whose name equals its file stem and a non-empty description
All session transcripts under ~/.claude/projects are still present
A plan listing each memory's destination was shown before any file changed
